rule:
Criterion (order 7.1): max of (1) the pooled spread of stage 2's prep (S2REAL/prep/ruler.json through s2_metrics.pooled_r) for the four
metrics the order names (past-shape inflow 1.64 %p, detail accuracy new reading 0.52 cm, missing-region completeness 0.2 m 3.29 %p,
observation-error inflow over the region 1.57 %p; config reading_rules 'others: null'), (2) the unit spread 2.8 |s0 - s1| / sqrt 2 of
the method's two seeds in that unit, (3) three points 300 / n %p for shares, n = the smaller sample of the two compared. Single-seed
comparators (2D Gaussian Splatting, GeoGS, CDGS): '확인' only beyond twice the criterion, between once and twice '가능, 근거 불완전'.
The fusions (MVS-based fusion, the judgment-swapped variant) are deterministic: beyond the criterion = '확인'. Fewer than 100 samples:
'표본 부족'. Past-shape inflow, observation-error inflow within the threshold and detail accuracy below 10,000 samples: at most
'가능, 근거 불완전'. B0's detail accuracy is not read; B173만 is report-only.
